subject: Pilot onramp: acceptance criteria & compute ask
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Emma Lawson <emma@kinetixhealth.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot onramp: acceptance criteria & compute ask

Thanks for the call earlier — quick recap and proposed next steps so we have an agreed runway for the pilot.

High-level success criteria (as discussed)
- 3 representative workflows validated end-to-end (ingest -> inference -> post-process)
- Avg 95th%-tile latency <= 250ms for interactive flows (90k tokens/session workload)
- Embedding-based search throughput >= 800 qps with <= 150ms p99
- No PII exfiltration; logs retained only in your VPC for 90 days

Evaluation plan and timeline
- Week 0 (this week): finalize SOW & capacity estimate (Redwood) -> deliverables attached
- Week 1: provisioning and integration window (network, keys, test dataset)
- Weeks 2–3: run evaluation harness & baseline comparisons (Kinetix + Redwood shared dashboards)
- Week 4: joint review and go/no-go decision (success criteria checklist)

Compute ask (pilot baseline)
- Reserved: 2 x A100 (40GB) for baseline (24/7)
- Burst: up to 8 concurrent GPUs during peak eval windows; autoscaling policy to allow 3x short bursts (<= 4 hours)
- KV cache enabled; suggested sequence lengths 1024 for interactive, 4096 for long-context batch runs

Ownership
- Redwood PM (Irene): pilot coordination, SOW, provisioning schedule
- Redwood SE (Monica): integration, test harness, runbooks
- Kinetix lead (Emma): dataset readiness, acceptance tests, procurement liaison

Immediate next steps
1) Emma — confirm procurement contact and budget window (you mentioned week to confirm)
2) Redwood — we will send the SOW + capacity estimate (attached) and a DocuSign link for pilot terms
3) Schedule a kickoff for provisioning (propose Jun 4 10:00 PT)

Attachments: kinetix-capacity-estimate.xlsx, redwood-pilot-terms.pdf

Cheers,
Irene
Irene Choi
Account Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Emma Lawson <emma@kinetixhealth.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-31T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot onramp: acceptance criteria & compute ask

Thanks Emma — quick answers on provisioning and burst.
- Lead time: for 2 reserved A100s we can provision within 48 hours after SOW signed and payment instruction; reserve window default is 30 days
- Burst model: bursts leverage our pooled capacity and do not require a separate reservation, but we do require an agreed burst ceiling in the SOW for priority preemption avoidance (we'll honor up to 8 GPUs during scheduled burst windows)
- Autoscaling: proposed policy = baseline 2 reserved -> scale by queue depth to max 8 -> scale-down cooldown 15m; we will also enable pre-warming for the KV cache ahead of scheduled test runs

Pricing note: baseline reserved GPUs priced per month; burst usage billed at peak-hour rate (estimates in attached capacity sheet). If procurement needs an estimate for a 30-day pilot vs a 90-day pilot we can generate both — tell us preferred window.

I'll loop infra to confirm exact provisioning SLA and tag the reservation so Monica can access the nodes for testing.

-Aditya
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Irene / Aditya — Procurement here. We have an initial set of redlines on the pilot terms and a PO workflow question:
- Can Redwood accept a short-form PO for the pilot (Net 30)?
- We require a 7 business day lead time for on-prem provisioning requests; for cloud reservations we need confirmation of the provisioning SLA prior to PO issuance

Redlines (summary):
1) Liability cap: prefer to cap at contract value for pilot
2) Data handling: need confirmation that logs & telemetry remain in our VPC and are deleted after 90 days unless we request retention

We uploaded the signed redline file to DocuSign: https://docusign.com/some-link/ABC123 — please confirm acceptance or propose an alternate clause by Jun 3 COB.

Regards,

- Provisioning lead time: infra confirmed 48 hours for 2 reserved A100s once SOW signed and payment instruction received; burst ceiling honored per SOW schedule

Operational owners (confirmed)
- Pilot PM: Irene Choi (Redwood) — overall coordination and SOW
- Technical lead: Monica Patel (Redwood) — integration, test harness, runbook ops
- Customer lead: Emma Lawson (Kinetix) — dataset & acceptance tests
- Billing/procurement contact: procurement@kinetixhealth.com

We will:
- Share final SOW + DocuSign link by today (attached)
- Provision the two reserved GPUs within 48 hours of signed DocuSign/PO
- Schedule kickoff: Jun 4 10:00 PT (invite will follow)

If everyone is aligned I'll mark the deal stage as "Pilot - Provisioning" in HubSpot and assign the internal playbook tasks. Monica — can you prepare the test harness checklist and send by EOD Jun 2 so we can keep Week 2 on track?

Thanks all,
Irene
